synthesizedFacts.fact: Ceramides are lipids that form a significant part of the skin barrier, crucial for hydration and protection.
Ceramides can be found in foods such as dairy products, eggs, whole grains, nuts, seeds, vegetables, meat, fish, and soy.
Ceramides help maintain the skin barrier, boost hydration, and reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles.
Ceramides are beneficial for conditions like eczema, psoriasis, and sensitive skin due to their role in restoring the skin barrier.
